items.heading: Pharmacy Is One
items.text: Pharmacy is one of the few health careers in India that is a licensed profession in its own right, separate from the allied-health/paramedical framework covered by the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP).

items.heading: Most Articles Frame These As
items.text: Most articles frame these as a ladder, D.Pharm, then B.Pharm, then Pharm.D, as if each one is simply "more" of the last. In practice, they lead to noticeably different work.
